reason: 该插件的核心面向用户是界面控件替换：在 DeepSeek Harness Web 输入区用 6 档滑块统一控制模型与推理强度，并提供悬停图示与切换动画。根据仓库说明与清单，该插件通过官方 DSH Web 插件注入点与 modelDirectories 会话接口实现选择映射，属前端界面布局/交互增强，未体现需要审批的高风险能力。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness Web 的输入区域加入一个 6 档滑动条，用于同时切换模型和推理等级，并在滑块状态变化时显示对应档位预览图。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a six-step slider to DeepSeek Harness Web input controls to switch model and reasoning level together, with a preview image for the active level shown during hover or switching.

capabilities: Replaces in-page model and reasoning-level controls with a 6-position slider UI
Maps slider positions to configured model/effort combinations
Calls Harness session/model selection APIs when the position changes
Displays local per-position preview imagery in the plugin bundle
Overrides conversation input model slot and restores default UI when uninstalled

reasons.code: README describes a front-end slider that replaces built-in model and reasoning controls and switches both together.
README documents that switching uses Harness modelDirectories/session.selectModel with model id and effort id.
package.json defines a DSH web client plugin with UI injection dependencies for conversation and model-selection packages.
README states slider level images are embedded into the client bundle as data URLs, avoiding runtime external static asset loading.
